shellCommands.command: git status --short && ls -la && cat package.json 2>/dev/null; find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -type f \( -name "*.tsx" -o -name "*.jsx" -o -name "*.ts" -o -name "*.js" -o -name "*.vue" \) -print | head -50

cat src/App.tsx src/main.tsx src/vite-env.d.ts AGENTS.md tsconfig.json vite.config.ts index.html; ls .agents/skills/gravity-ui/ .agents/skills/gravity-ui/*; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json | grep '"version"'; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs 2>/dev/null | head; ls __agent_eval__

head -60 .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md; echo ----; cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md; echo ----; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs/components 2>/dev/null | head -80

cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh | head -30; echo ----; timeout 20 curl -sS -o /tmp/uikit-llms.txt -w "%{http_code}\n" https://gravity-ui.com/llms/uikit/7/llms.txt; wc -c /tmp/uikit-llms.txt 2>/dev/null; echo ----; .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit DropdownMenu Button 2>&1 | head -80

bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit DropdownMenu 2>&1 | head -40; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/ | head -50; find node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build -iname "*DropdownMenu*" | head -20

cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/DropdownMenu/DropdownMenu.d.ts; echo ----; grep -n -B2 -A30 "^## DropdownMenu\|DropdownMenu.md" /tmp/uikit-llms.txt | head -20; echo; grep -n "renderSwitcher\|DropdownMenuItemProps\|DropdownMenuProps" -r node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/DropdownMenu/*.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/DropdownMenu/*.d.ts | head; find node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/DropdownMenu -name "*.d.ts"

cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/DropdownMenu/types.d.ts; echo ----; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/DropdownMenu/index.d.ts; echo ----; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/ArrowToggle/ArrowToggle.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -40; echo ----; grep -n "view\|size" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Button/Button.d.ts | head -20; grep -rn "export" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/index.d.ts | head -3; grep -n "DropdownMenu\|ArrowToggle\|Button\|Text\b" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/index.d.ts | head

grep -rn "MenuItemProps\b" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Menu/*.d.ts | head -3; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Menu/types.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -60; grep -n "ButtonView =" -A3 node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Button/types.d.ts; grep -n "view\|size" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Button/Button.d.ts | head; grep -n "export type ButtonSize" -A2 -r node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Button/ | head -5

cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Menu/MenuItem.d.ts | head -20; grep -n "BUTTON_VIEWS" -A12 node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Button/constants.d.ts | head -20; ls node_modules/.bin | grep -E "^(tsc|vite)$"
npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | head -30; echo "tsc exit: ${PIPESTATUS[0]}"; npx vite build 2>&1 | tail -8
